text:
marco: Quick idea for the pricing calculator exit flow: when someone finishes the calc, show a compact "Next step" micro-panel that does three things: 1) captures intent (demo/webinar/self-serve), 2) surfaces a one-line FAQ snippet tailored to the estimate, 3) optionally seeds a short checkbox to receive an invite to a short webinar. Low friction. Thoughts?

tess: Love it. Keep it inline, no modal. For FAQ snips, map estimate bands -> blurb: < $500 -> 'Self-serve guidance & docs', $500-$1500 -> 'Consider Reserved for cost savings', >$1500 -> 'Reserved capacity with SLA'.

olivia: Copy tests: headline variants: A) "Pick what works next" B) "Choose how you'd like to proceed". CTA variants to test as well: "Book a demo" vs "Talk to sales". We'll microtest both.

sam: Tracking requirement: fire one event on the user's final selection. Example payload:
```
window.dataLayer.push({
  event: 'pricing_next_step',
  chosen_path: 'demo|webinar|self',
  estimate_usd: 1840,
  frontend_label: 'Reserved plan',
  backend_bucket: 'committed|considering|low',
  exp_id: 'exp_pricing_exit_42'
});
```
Also send webhook for demo leads when backend_bucket == 'committed' and estimate_usd >= 1500.

ana: Sales Ops: we want lead_shape: {email, company, estimate_usd, bucket, preferred_cta}. Prefer threshold at $1500/mo. Also flag is_enterprise_candidate true/false. Please mask any prompt content.

marco: UX: micro-panel will show pills for the three paths + a small line of explanatory microcopy. If demo selected and estimate > threshold, show a checkbox: "Also invite me to the next webinar on Dedicated capacity" (opt-in).

olivia: Tier naming microtest idea: in the micro-panel only, test two naming sets for the reserved label: Set 1 = Reserved / Burst / Managed ; Set 2 = Dedicated / Flexible / Hosted. No sitewide change. We'll ladder microcopy under them.

tess: Accessibility: ensure pills are focusable and the chosen state announced. Also ensure the micro-survey checkbox is reachable by keyboard and screen readers.

analytics-bot: Experiment created: pricing_exit_path_v2 (exp_pricing_exit_42). Assignment via client experiments. Start date 2026-05-12.

sam: Measurement plan: primary = demo booking rate per visitor; secondary = webinar signup rate, demo->paid after 30d. Also capture drop-off if they close micro-panel.

sales-ops-bot: Notifying sales-team: /cc @sales-team. Expect webhook updates and lead routing changes on rollout.

marco: Timeline: design mocks by Tue, tracking spec + webhook by Wed, dev build Thu, staging QA Fri, 5% rollout next Tue. We'll hold a short sync Mon to confirm analytics fields.

olivia: I'll prepare copy matrix for headline + CTA + FAQ snippets. ETA EOD today.

tess: Mocking now. Push the visual treatment as an inline panel under calculator results; don't push content down too much.

sam: Dev note: debounce event so we only send pricing_next_step on final selection or CTA click; avoid spamming when users toggle. Also include session_id & utm params for joins.

analytics-bot: Add experiment metadata to all events: {exp_id: 'exp_pricing_exit_42', variant: 'A|B'}.

marco: One more ask: include a tiny privacy blurb when routing to sales for regulated sectors: "We will not share prompts without your consent." Link to FAQ.

sales-ops-bot: Confirmed acceptance criteria for webhook: must include is_enterprise_candidate boolean and preferred_cta_label string.

marco: Great work. I'll collate notes into the experiment doc and share the rollout checklist. Thanks team :thumbsup:
